'''Speeder-rafts''' were [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-driven [[Water/Legends|water]] surface vehicles capable of carrying four people each. Two of them were carried aboard the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Multi-environment Space Boat]] [[Explorer (space boat)|''Explorer'']] during its mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]].<ref name="BGS" />
